extra.final_summary: Fixed data quality issues for the body-mass-by-species question: (1) normalized 2 space-variant species labels (" Adelie", "Adelie ") to "Adelie"; (2) cast body_mass_g from text (with commas like "3,450") to numeric. All 55 rows used; no out-of-range body masses (2500–6500g). Average body mass: Adelie ≈ 3767.24 g, Chinstrap ≈ 3726.79 g, Gentoo ≈ 4895.83 g. Note: flipper_length_mm and year are stored as text but not needed for this question; sex has 1 missing value (not used here).
